state.persona: Sam, invited friend on an iPhone, first time using dope.travel. Joined Matt's Lisbon trip as 'Sam'.
state.job: Vote on the ideas I care about and send my votes back to Matt.
state.workflow_state: After tapping 'Join and vote', the page is /trips/designer. The page is about 21,200 px tall on a 844 px screen (about 25 screens). The panel with 'Send my picks back' starts at about 20,840 px, i.e. at the very bottom, after 6 days of idea-card rows, a live research panel with 10 tabs and a 'Where you'll stay' panel.
state.visible_text_top: Hero card: 'PORTUGAL · THU, OCT 15 → TUE, OCT 20 · 5 NIGHTS', 'Lisbon', 'Streets to wander, tables to find, nights to remember.', '21 days UNTIL WHEELS UP', badges 'Drafted on this device', '2 loves so far'. Toolbar: 'Voting as' chips '😎 Matt' and '🌺 Sam' (Sam highlighted), [Curated] [Group faves] [All] [Loved] [Sam: to vote] [New trip]. Help text: 'Drag cards between time slots (or use “Move to…”), tap ★ to make one the pick, and pass the phone around to vote. Votes save on this device; tap “Invite people” below to let friends vote on their own phones and send their picks back. Cards are ideas: check hours, prices, and bookings with each venue.' Then 'LISBON, RIGHT NOW' research panel with a [Refresh] button. Each idea card has 👍 and 👎 buttons.
state.visible_text_bottom_panel: 'YOU'RE ON MATT'S TRIP' / 'Vote as Sam, then send your picks back. They merge into the organizer's plan.' [Send my picks back] [Share the trip]. After tapping: 'Link copied. Send it to Matt.' plus a textarea with a long http://.../trips/join#r=... link. Footnote: 'Anyone with the link can see the plan and who's going (names, kids' ages, home city). Music taste stays on your device. Picks sync when a link is opened, not live.'
state.note: There is no 'Invite people' button on the friend's copy (it says 'Share the trip'); nothing at the top tells the friend where the send-back step is; votes are not sent anywhere automatically.

finds_send_back.instructions: Probability Sam, after voting on a few cards on the phone, finds the 'Send my picks back' button without help within 2 minutes.

thinks_votes_already_sent.instructions: Probability Sam believes Matt can already see their votes after tapping thumbs up/down (without sending a link), and stops there.

understands_send_back.instructions: Probability that after tapping 'Send my picks back' and seeing 'Link copied. Send it to Matt.', Sam understands they must paste this new link into a message to Matt, and Matt must open it on the device where he planned the trip.

toolbar_matt_chip.instructions: Probability Sam taps the 'Matt' chip in 'Voting as' at some point (curiosity or thinking it filters Matt's picks) and then votes as Matt by mistake.

completion.instructions: Overall, how likely is this flow to end with Sam's votes correctly reaching Matt?
